name: Steel Swarm: INVASION
detailed_description:
The world is collapsing under the swarm. As chaos spreads, survival depends on your ability to fight, adapt, and command the battlefield. Step into the war, where every choice shapes your fate, and every moment is a battle for control.

FIGHT!

Fight through swarms in a destructible world, switching between brutal on-foot combat and devastating vehicle warfare. Navigate intense battlefields where everything around you crumbles under the force of war. Move seamlessly between ground assaults and mechanized warfare, using environmental destruction to your advantage. Whether clearing enemies on foot or unleashing devastation from your war machine, every fight demands strategy, reflexes, and adaptability.

BUILD!

Build your war machine, upgrading parts to dominate the battlefield. From battered scrap to an unstoppable force, your vehicle is yours to shape. Equip powerful weapons, reinforce armor, and optimize every system to match your combat style. Whether favoring speed, firepower, or resilience, customization determines survival. Gather resources, unlock upgrades, and create the perfect war machine for the relentless fight ahead.

LEVEL UP!

Master an innovative character system, shaping your approach to combat and decision-making. Level up critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication, each directly impacting your playstyle. Your choices define how you fight, adapt, and influence the war around you.

EXPLORE!

Explore a war-torn world, uncovering secrets, scavenging resources, and forging alliances through dialogue. The battlefield holds more than destruction—hidden knowledge, vital supplies, and crucial relationships await those who seek them. Conversations can unlock new strategies, while the ruins of war hide valuable tools for survival. Your path is shaped by curiosity, exploration, and the alliances you forge in the shadows of conflict.

The war is relentless, but your choices matter. Steel Swarm Invasion is yours to shape—wishlist now and prepare for battle.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel 8th Gen I5 and above
  • Graphics: NVidia 1060 or newer
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 14
  • Processor: Intel 8th Gen I5 and above
  • Graphics: NVidia 1060 or newer
